hooks.name: health-before-stop
hooks.description: Run npm run health in game/ when the agent tries to stop; if red, keep it working with the reason 'health is red' (KDEV-03, D-161)

action.command: cd game && if npm run health >/tmp/kiro-health.log 2>&1; then echo 'health is green' >&2; else tail -n 40 /tmp/kiro-health.log >&2; printf '%s' '{"decision":"block","reason":"health is red"}'; fi
